AND I WON'T.|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 14 ([[The Great Finale]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Right Hand''', internally referred to as the '''Hand Boss Right''', alongside the [[Left Hand]], was the final boss of the [[The Great Finale|third]] act in the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a high amount of health, much higher than any other enemy before it, but it could not enter the base like other enemies and did not take damage the same way as other enemies. As it is a boss enemy, it was immune to being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], could not be frozen by freezing towers and could only be slowed down by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. The '''Right Hand''' had four abilities: #The first ability, ''Temper Fist'', made it move towards a tower, ball up to a fist and smash it, creating a shockwave that stunned any tower. #Its second ability, ''Finger Gun'', made it fire multiple missiles from its index finger at random towers, stunning any tower caught in the explosion. #Its third ability, ''Vanquish'', made it move towards a tower, grab it, squash it and then return to its original position, which killed the tower. It can do this multiple times in a row. #Its last ability, ''Summoning Trickery'', made it dangle its fingers over a path, summoning five enemies, which could be any enemy that appeared before it. ==Appearance== The '''Right Hand''' was a disembodied human hand wearing a white glove. The '''Right Hand''' had a death animation where it would make various hand signals before shrinking into nothing and emitting confetti after it disappeared. ==Strategy== *[[Spotlight]]s are the only reliable way to attack the '''Right Hand''' and [[Left Hand]]. **Both the '''Right Hand''' and [[Left Hand]] cannot be targeted by towers directly, but can still be damaged indirectly from explosions or stray projectiles. **Enemies that spawn around the map have a chance of dropping a single [[Battery]] when killed. These should be collected before Wave 14, as each [[Spotlight]] requires 10 [[Battery|Batteries]] to be used. ***In cases of emergency, it can also be used to confuse enemies coming towards the exit, so that you do not lose from them. **It is recommended to stay next to the [[Spotlight]] which will have its duration end soon, so that it can be quickly activated again. After this, move to the next [[Spotlight]] which has the lowest amount of time before it deactivates. **The '''Right Hand''' has several abilities that allow it to quickly move around the map. Players using [[Spotlight]] should reaim them as fast as possible. *The '''Right Hand''' cannot kill the player by itself, but the enemies that spawn alongside it will without enough DPS, especially when combined with the '''Right Hand''' and [[Left Hand]]'s abilities. **Multiple high DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended to deal with them. **Towers like the [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective against them when there are multiple of them placed down. **The [[Medic]] is a reliable tower to cleanse stuns. *Do note that the '''Right Hand''' can kill your towers. **It is advised to have bait towers, however it is not a requirement since the only way to kill the Right '''Hand''' is by using the [[Spotlight]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Loss |- |[[File:HandBossAct3Laugh.oga]] |Plays upon losing |} }} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TDSAct3Icon2.png|'''Right Hand''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} LunarOverturePI4.jpg|'''Right Hand''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Act 3 Cutscene 3-4 - Scrapped - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Right Hand''' in the scrapped opening [[The Great Finale]] cutscene. Night 2 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Right Hand''' in the [[Banlands]] cutscenes. Night 3 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Right Hand''' in the [[Blind Faith]] cutscenes. "The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Right Hand''' in the [[The Narratorium]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Stickers}} ClappingRightyAndLeftySticker.png|'''Right Hand''' on the [[Clapping Righty and Lefty]] sticker }} ==Trivia== *The '''Right Hand''' was given to the [[Narrator (Story)|Narrator]] as a gift from [[Lord Exo]]. Its name is ''Righty''. *The '''Right Hand''' was most likely inspired by the [https://www.ssbwiki.com/Master_Hand Master Hand] from ''Super Smash Bros''. **The fact that the '''Right Hand''' has 300,000 health could also be a reference to the [https://www.ssbwiki.com/Master_Hand Master Hand] having 300 health in ''Super Smash Bros''. *After losing to the [[Left Hand]] and '''Right Hand''', a laugh could be heard. *This along with the [[Left Hand]] are the second bosses to have the ability to kill towers, with the first being the [[Raider Boss]]. *The '''Right Hand''' spawned shortly after the [[Left Hand]]. *When summoning enemies, the enemies were called "''Hand Boss Right's _____''" instead of "''Right Hand's _____''". *The '''Right Hand''' would indirectly return as an [[Enemy|enemy]] in [[The Narratorium]] as part of the [[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]]. ==Update History== *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **'''Right Hand''' added. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Right Hand''' removed. {{TheGreatFinale|[[Actor3 (Lunar Overture)|Actor3]]|Wave 12|[[Left Hand]] & Right Hand|Wave 14|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
